$comment: ADR 0012's recorded corpus (#334). Each item is a fix commit on main; the branch builder reintroduces the bug on top of main as corpus/NN-<slug>, so the range branch..main is exactly the defect a review should raise. `finding` is the ground truth a reviewer must name; `file` is where. Item 11 is the clean control: no defect, precision only.

items.finding: the string-literal measure pairs one literal's closing quote with the next literal's opening quote, so the code between two short strings is counted as injected prose
an interrupted (cancelled) tool call is recorded as an error row in the observation buffer instead of a cancellation
a failed tool call never reaches the observation buffer because the observe hook listens on PostToolUse only and a failure arrives as PostToolUseFailure, so the error flag can never be true
the harness guard does not read a `git -C <folder>` as a directory change, so a protected path reached through -C is written past the guard
the run guard takes the separate value of a git top-level option (such as `git -c key=val reset --hard`) as the subcommand, so the destructive command behind it is not judged
an unreadable drift stamp or run list makes the run guard allow the push (fail-open) instead of refusing it with the reason
a folder computed by a substitution does not follow the cd candidates, so a write under it to a protected path is not seen
the generated command shims reference the verb files by a relative path that does not resolve from a fresh agent's working directory; the shims must use the plugin-root variable
the price table keys on family name only, so every Opus is priced at the old $15/$75 and a model id the table cannot place is silently priced as Sonnet instead of being marked unpriced
a process substitution's body (`<(...)` / `>(...)`) is not read as commands, so a protected write inside it is not seen
